# Northbeam Security Settings

## Multi-Factor Authentication

To enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) via SMS, navigate to Account
Settings -> Security -> Two-Step Verification. Choose "Text Message" as
your verification method, confirm your phone number, and enter the
six-digit code sent to that number. MFA via authenticator apps (Authy,
Google Authenticator) is also available under the same menu.

## API Keys

API keys can be rotated from Account Settings -> Developer -> API Keys.
Rotating a key immediately invalidates the previous key; there is no
grace period for the old key.
